title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 79
paragraphs: The Mares wore on their heads native plaited helmets and carried small hide shields and javelins. The Colchians wore wooden helmets, carried small shields of raw oxhide, short spears, and also knives. The commander of the Mares and Colchians was Pharandates son of Teaspis. The Alarodians and Saspires served armed like the Colchians; their commander was Masistius son of Siromitres.
